UFC DraftKings Network MMA Ryan Wohl breaks down more information regarding the latest news of Gable Steveson signing with the UFC. Updated Apr 12, 2026 7:08 PM EDT By Ryan Wohl opens in a new tab DETROIT, MI - MARCH 19: Gable Steveson of the Minnesota Golden Gophers defeats Cohlton Schultz of the Arizona State Sun Devils in the 285-pound final match during the Division I Men's Wrestling Championship held at Little Caesars Arena on March 19, 2022 in Detroit, Michigan. (Photo by Jay LaPrete/NCAA Photos/NCAA Photos via Getty Images) Audio By Carbonatix The UFC announced during the UFC 327 broadcast that they have signed 2020 Olympic Gold Medalist Gable Steveson. Steveson is set to make his UFC debut at UFC 329 on July 11 at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada. UFC 329 is part of International Fight Week. RELATED UFC 327 results, live updates, round-by-round scoring Steveson is one of the greatest collegiate wrestlers in history, as he won two NCAA Division 1 Championships and four Big Ten Championships. Since entering MMA, Steveson has gone 3-0 with three wins by KO/TKO. Steveson has been training with former two-division UFC Champion Jon Jones. Add DKN as preferred source on Google.
